title: Closeout summary: S02T02 - Implement safe execution policy for declared verification gates
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Implemented the safe declared-gate execution boundary: only required closeout gate declarations are accepted; commands use strict token parsing with no shell or expansion, policy-approved executables, workspace-contained real cwd, allowlisted/redacted environment keys, bounded time/output, dry-run preview, and abort-signal cancellation.

Close reason: Untrusted work text cannot execute; approved gate commands now have a bounded, previewable, cancellable, workspace-confined execution policy.
